summary: Checkpoint adoption cannot make envelope sealing skip new local claims by reusing deleted batch rowids

replay.detail: On first open with this fix, reset the envelope-sealing frontier once. The existing 64-batch sealing chunks revisit retained batches with signing keys loaded and recover local batches skipped by older builds. No graph projection replay is added.

schema.detail: No table, column or index changes. Transactional batch_rowid_high_water metadata prevents reuse of deleted batch keys in both local append and peer admission.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, proof invariants, certificates and manifests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Batch rowids are local scan keys and are not part of signed batch or envelope identities. Older peers retain the same wire protocol.

downtime.detail: No downtime beyond the normal daemon restart. Existing stores revisit retained batch headers once in bounded sealing chunks; already sealed batches are skipped.

manual.detail: No manual repair. Reachable-member read-only counts found zero retained claims without a source envelope or a claim tombstone.

recovery.detail: Deploy forward. An older writer can reintroduce rowid reuse and skipped envelope sealing after checkpoint deletion.
